subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible GitHub Copilot models automatically replace managed-provider selection with Copilot-native search when `tools.web.search.provider` is unset, or require the existing explicit native selection?
rationale: Both paths are technically implementable, but the current branch changes existing users' effective search provider during upgrade; repository policy treats provider routing and defaults as compatibility-sensitive product intent.

options.title: Preserve current routing
options.body: Require explicit native selection so existing unset-provider Copilot installations continue using managed-provider selection.

options.title: Adopt automatic native search
options.body: Approve the unset-provider switch to Copilot-native search and require clear upgrade documentation plus live provider proof.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the PR and linked issue open until maintainers are ready to define the permanent Copilot search-routing contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve current routing
recommendation.body: Require explicit native selection so existing unset-provider Copilot installations continue using managed-provider selection.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history most strongly connects this person to Copilot runtime, direct OpenAI native search, and plugin-SDK boundary decisions.
